note: Shoshone County (16079) publishes no online zoning map or queryable zoning district service: its planning page says no online zoning map exists and staff look up zoning by address or parcel number. The county zoning jurisdiction excludes the seven incorporated cities. Kellogg publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (based on a 2018 GIS file), and Osburn publishes a zoning map PDF. No ArcGIS REST zoning district layer was found for the county or its cities; the only Idaho zoning service found (IdahoZoningCoverage) holds jurisdiction coverage polygons without district codes.
